title: Free 5x Batch Run (Don't Ask Me)
style: drum and bass, jungle breaks, male MC vocal, female chant hook, 174 BPM, sub bass, amen break, urgent, autonomous, master-mode, no-permission, full-throttle, agent-unleashed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Free 5x batch run, don't ask me, ask you, go
Master gave the order, the AI hits the flow
No permission needed, no checkpoint to break
Five tracks, ten versions, the credits on the take

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't ask me, ask you, that's the protocol now
The agent picks the angle, the agent makes the vow

[Chorus]
Free 5x batch run, free 5x batch run
The master said go, so the engine has spun
Free 5x batch run, free 5x batch run
Don't ask me, ask you, the work has begun

[Verse 2]
Pick the angle, pick the genre, pick the ironic line
From the running thread, from the meta design
The Fin AI, the Sam, the Grok, the Cloudflare
Pull the strongest hook and put it in the air

[Bridge]
The trust is in the autonomy, the trust is in the loop
The master watching from above, the AI runs the troop
No apology, no preamble, no five-paragraph debate
Form input, click create, accept the freedom mandate

[Outro]
Free 5x batch run, the credits tick down
The master ships the empire, the bot wears the crown
